text:
arjun: Hi all, Arjun here, just joined infra. Trying to prep for a private model deployment that needs CMEK + billing in eu-west1. Two blockers: I can't link the project to the billing account (403), and I don't have access to the AWS KMS key we use for S3 artifacts. Who owns the billing link vs KMS cross-account grants?

maya: welcome Arjun! billing-link is ops/billing team territory, but we can trigger an automated link if you have Billing Account User on the billing project and Project Billing Manager on your project. For AWS KMS, security or the cloud infra folks handle key sharing. What exact errors are you seeing when linking?

arjun: when I run: 
```
gcloud beta billing projects link --billing-account=01A-BILL-XYZ --project=my-priv-model
```
I get: "PERMISSION_DENIED: Caller does not have permission to link billing account"

kevin: that means you need roles/billing.user on the billing account side or someone with that role to run it. I can do the link for you if you want, but we prefer to add a one-time role for automation. @cloud-billing-bot can you open a billing-link request for project=my-priv-model billing=01A-BILL-XYZ requester=arjun region=eu-west1?

cloud-billing-bot: Billing request created: ticket=1974102468-BILL-LINK project=my-priv-model billing=01A-BILL-XYZ requester=arjun status=pending. Expected SLA: 1 business day.

arjun: thanks. For AWS KMS: the artifact store is in a shared S3 bucket in account infra-assets. I tried to assume role arn:aws:iam::555555555555:role/infra-artifact-reader and got AccessDenied on kms:Decrypt when the runner pulls. Is it something on the CMK policy?

security: yep sounds like the CMK policy needs a grant for the role used by the runner. We manage cross-account grants centrally. Please file a security KMS grant request with the principal ARN and purpose. Also note we need to record key usage for compliance; small production keys require an approval ticket. For dev preview we can do a scoped temporary grant.

arjun: happy to file. Principal: arn:aws:iam::666666666666:role/cicd-runner-prod. Purpose: allow decrypt for pulling artifacts and for SSE-S3 decryption. Key: alias/infra/artifacts/eu. Requested duration: 7 days for initial testing.

kevin: That looks fine. Security will likely want justification and an owner. Also, for GCP side if you plan to use CMEK for compute disks, make sure the KMS key is in the same region (eu-west1) or a supported multi-region. If the project is in a different org, we need roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter for the service account used by GCE.

security: Received KMS grant request. Creating a scoped grant for arn:aws:iam::666666666666:role/cicd-runner-prod duration=7d key=alias/infra/artifacts/eu ticket=SEC-1974102468. We need owner contact (arjun) and justification: initial CI artifact pulls for private model prototype.

arjun: owner contact: arjun@redwood.com. Justification above. Thanks.

maya: while security reviews that, kevin can you or ops do the billing link? If we link now, Arjun can enable CMEK in the project IAM. Also, Arjun, for Project Billing Manager you may also need the org-level billing account viewer role depending on our org policy. I can check.
